calls.thesis: United Rentals, equipment rental: needs equipment to build data centers, power plants and fiber; benefits from broader reshoring/nearshoring capex too; market prices earnings flat vs 2023-24, missing the story.
calls.base: Capex $200B to $465B to $800B trajectory plus specialty-rental scale/moat (12% ROA on uniform basis); he calls it '100% a buying opportunity'.
calls.bear: Equipment rental is cyclical; a capex slowdown would hit utilization and pricing.
calls.video_title: The AI Boom Is Creating Blue Collar Millionaires (3 Stocks You'll Wish You Bought)
